architecture.residual_unit_clarification: Each registered residual block is one pre-activation GroupNorm-GELU-dilated-Conv1d branch plus an identity skip. This outcome-blind implementation clarification keeps the prescribed channel/kernel/dilation sequence below the frozen parameter ceiling; a two-convolution branch would exceed it.
architecture.ordered_pool_implementation: The 16 adaptive-average bin boundaries are evaluated explicitly as means over floor(iL/16):ceil((i+1)L/16), because PyTorch 2.9 CUDA does not provide a deterministic backward kernel for AdaptiveAvgPool1d. This is mathematically the registered adaptive averaging operation and was locked after a terminal pre-outcome smoke-test failure.

optimization.final_refit_epoch_rule: For each selected candidate and seed, use the rounded median best epoch across that outer context's authorized inner selection units, clipped to [30,200]; train on all authorized outer-source rows for exactly that many epochs.
selection_objective: mean selection-unit balanced accuracy descending after equal seed averaging
worst selection-unit balanced accuracy descending after equal seed averaging
mean selection-unit macro-F1 descending after equal seed averaging
lower fixed candidate complexity rank ascending
optimization.t1_inner_units: the three non-test outer master folds
optimization.t3_inner_units: P02 supported leave-one-source-instrument-out pseudo-domains; exact P02 three-fold source-master-CV fallback when fewer than two are supported
optimization.temperature_calibration: one scalar per outer context and neural seed fitted only to selected-candidate master-disjoint inner validation logits with equal total weight per physical master
optimization.seed_ensemble: average calibrated probabilities across all complete registered neural seeds before endpoint scoring

augmentation.noise_sigma_conversion: selected first-difference MAD ratio divided by 0.9538725524
augmentation.rng_derivation: SHA-256 of fit ID, training seed, epoch, batch ordinal, and augmentation version
augmentation.logging: fit-level source-only quantiles plus deterministic draw digest/count/ranges provide exact replay without publishing row identities

execution.selection_checkpoint_retention: best-state hash and complete history retained; interim selection weights are transient
execution.final_checkpoint_retention: one immutable final checkpoint per complete outer context and neural seed

gates.collapse_definition: best validation prediction contains fewer than two predicted classes
gates.underfit_definition: best training balanced accuracy is no more than station-local chance plus 0.05
gates.overfit_definition: best-epoch training minus validation balanced accuracy exceeds 0.20
gates.instability_definition: last-ten validation balanced-accuracy standard deviation exceeds 0.15 or more than half of optimizer steps are gradient-clipped
gates.held_evaluation_authorization: G2 is evaluated from EXP-N00-DEV optimization records only; no development outer-test metric and no P03/P13 held outcome participates. A failed G2 preserves the negative result and blocks EXP-N00-T3.

comparison.paired_unit: outer domain by repeat by fold
